package proto

import "sync/atomic"

// interruptRequested is the Go-side interrupt flag (atomic, as in the engine's
// current interruptHandler). host_poll latches it into interruptLatched and
// reports it. It has a normal Go prologue, so GC can stop a loop here.
var (
	interruptRequested atomic.Int64
	interruptLatched    atomic.Int64
	pollCount           atomic.Int64
)

//go:noinline
func host_poll(sp uintptr) int64 {
	pollCount.Add(1)
	if interruptRequested.Load() != 0 {
		interruptLatched.Store(1)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
